# Communication Guide / Guide de communication

## Channels / Canaux

| Channel | Purpose | Language |
|---------|---------|----------|
| [Discord](https://discord.gg/xjF8Rtzyd4) | Support, discussion, announcements | FR / EN |
| [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Team-Arcadia/Arcadia-V2-Client/issues) | Bug reports, feature requests | FR / EN |
| [Website](https://arcadia-echoes-of-power.fr/) | News, changelog, partner program | FR / EN |
| [Support tickets](https://arcadia-echoes-of-power.fr/support/tickets) | Server-side / account issues | FR / EN |

## For Players / Pour les joueurs

- **Bug in the pack?** Use the [bug report template](https://github.com/Team-Arcadia/Arcadia-V2-Client/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- **Feature / balance idea?** Use the [feature request template](https://github.com/Team-Arcadia/Arcadia-V2-Client/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) or [suggestion form](https://arcadia-echoes-of-power.fr/suggest)
- **Crash from a third-party mod?** Report it on **the mod author's tracker** — we cannot fix mods we did not author (see `LICENSE` scope)
- **Quick question or account help?** Ask on [Discord](https://discord.gg/xjF8Rtzyd4) or open a [support ticket](https://arcadia-echoes-of-power.fr/support/tickets)

## For Contributors / Pour les contributeurs

- Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before submitting code
- Use the [Pull Request template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) for all PRs
- Target the right base branch per the branch strategy in CONTRIBUTING.md
- Security issues go through [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), never public issues

## Response Times / Delais de reponse

| Type | Expected Response |
|------|------------------|
| Security vulnerability | < 48 hours |
| Bug report (critical / progression-blocker) | < 72 hours |
| Bug report (minor / cosmetic) | < 2 weeks |
| Feature request | < 2 weeks |
| Pull request review | < 1 week |
| Third-party mod issue | Redirected to the upstream author |

## Language Policy / Politique linguistique

- **Issues and PRs**: English or French
- **Code, KubeJS scripts, commit messages**: English
- **In-game / UI text**: EN + FR via lang files (and 5 more languages for FTB Quests)
- **Documentation files**: bilingual EN + FR when ergonomic
